name: PR detail Overview shows the Blast radius map
description: From PR #482 (Overview is the default tab), confirm the Blast radius card lists the symbols the seeded diff touches, expand a symbol and see its caller file:line plus endpoint and cron chips. Read-only seeded data (demo repo-intel index in the seed, no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
the Blast radius card renders on Overview
a symbol touched by the seeded diff is listed
an endpoint that depends on it renders as a chip
the cron that depends on the other symbol renders as a chip
